resources.string: A big number showing how many days in a row you have kept a habit going.
One habit as a progress ring. Tap it to log the habit.
This week as bars, Monday to Sunday, for one habit.
A line showing how one habit went over the last 30 days.
This month as dots: done, missed, today and still to come.
Your habits as small progress rings, what is left to do first.
Today\'s habits as a list, tap one to log it.
